# Andre Willis — Director of College Access & Mentoring

- **Relationship:** direct report; one of Cam's four directors.
- **Owns:** the [Bright Futures — Fall Cohort](../projects/bright-futures-fall.md) and the
  wrapping [Bright Futures — Spring Cohort](../projects/bright-futures-spring.md) mentoring
  programs, plus the college-enrollment outcomes work.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Wednesdays.

## What he cares about
- Getting first-generation students into and through college; the 88% enrollment rate is his pride.
- Recruiting and training volunteer mentors — the pipeline is his perennial bottleneck.

## Notes
- Calm, organized, great with families. Runs the cleanest program data at Keystone.
- Partners with [CityReach](marcus-odom.md) on shared mentor recruitment.
